input.prompt: ONE photorealistic PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, horizontal 16:9, split into THREE equal vertical panels side by side with thin white gutters, all three showing the SAME object or place with identical design, materials and colours. BRAND: Bolly Eats, a cheeky Indian food delivery brand. Colours: masala maroon #5B1A1F, turmeric yellow #F4B400, chilli red #E2462B, rose pink #E8889A, warm cream #FFF4E0. The logo is EXACTLY as in image 1: three wavy steam lines above the lowercase words 'bolly eats.' in a heavy rounded grotesque, spelled b-o-l-l-y e-a-t-s with the full stop. Reproduce the logo exactly, never invent other text. THE PROP, the hero of the film: an open Bolly Eats takeaway fries box, a sturdy turmeric-yellow #F4B400 paperboard scoop box with the masala-maroon logo from image 1 printed on the front, lightly grease-spotted and slightly crumpled from being passed around. It is ALMOST EMPTY: just a few crumbs of red masala seasoning on the bottom and ONE single golden crinkle-cut masala fry left, dusted with red chilli spice, lying alone inside. Sitting on a warm oak coffee table. PANEL 1 (left): front three-quarter view at table height, logo readable. PANEL 2 (middle): looking straight down into the box, the lone fry sharp in focus. PANEL 3 (right): extreme close-up macro of the single fry with its spice texture, shallow depth of field. Moody warm evening lamp light. Real photography, true-to-life colour, subtle film grain, natural imperfections, believable and lived-in, not a render, not a cartoon. No people, no hands, no watermark.
